Playwright.Comment: BrowserType: Chromium | Firefox. Channel (Chromium only): empty = Playwright's bundled Chromium, or 'msedge' / 'chrome' to use the installed browser (required for Entra ID device-based sign-in). Set Headless=false for local debugging. Timeout in ms for all Playwright waits.

QA.Name: QA
QA.Description: QA environment (requires RDP access / Conditional Access exception)

ParallelExecution.Comment: Set Enabled=true to run scenarios in parallel. MaxDegreeOfParallelism: number of concurrent browser instances. Reqnroll requires scenario-level isolation (each scenario gets its own browser/context/page).

TestAccounts.Comment: Do NOT put usernames, passwords, or TOTP secret keys directly in this file. Resolve them at runtime from a secrets vault (1Password Connect, Azure Key Vault, etc.), mirroring the Coral.Testing pattern.

Authentication.Comment: OAuth = target API uses Entra ID; tests use the saved-session sign-in below. WinAuth = target API uses Windows auth; no sign-in step (add --auth-server-allowlist to Playwright:Args).

SessionState.Comment: Saved-session sign-in. Directory (relative to bin/) holds {env}.storageState.json + {env}.sessionStorage.json, reused while younger than CacheTTL seconds. If missing/expired, a visible browser opens and waits up to SignInTimeoutSeconds for a manual sign-in (needs Headless=false). EnableCaching=false forces a fresh sign-in every run. Files contain live tokens - never commit them.
